ctx.x: And the next thing I knew I was -- I was playing. And Sinatra -- like you said, it was Sinatra's birthday, and he brought some booze or something, and he put it right within Paul Gonzalves Gonzalez's reach. I said, "That's the wrong place to put it." So after the date was over we started -- Sam and Jeff Castleman -- that's his name, I think.
